readyToLaunchSection.title: Start Your SHAMS Free Zone Business
paragraphs: Whether you're a freelancer, content creator, or e-commerce entrepreneur — SHAMS Free Zone is the UAE's top choice for flexible, fast, and future-ready company formation.

We help you with end-to-end setup services including trade license, visa, and business bank account assistance. With quick approvals, planned costs, and no hidden fees, SHAMS is the ideal location for digital creators, consultants, and small business owners.
We handle everything from license to launch — so you can stay focused on growing your brand.

sidebarCard.title: Still Have Questions?
sidebarCard.text: Get a free consultation with our SHAMS specialists.
sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about SHAMS Free Zone.

items.q: How fast can I get my SHAMS license?
items.a: The whole company setup process takes about 3-5 working days with all documents properly prepared. Our end-to-end coordination means your business can be operational in less than a week.

items.q: Can I get a visa with my SHAMS license?
items.a: Yes. SHAMS allows visa quotas based on your license and package. We handle investor, employment, and family visas end-to-end.

items.q: What if I am working from a physical location outside the UAE?
items.a: SHAMS allows 100% remote setup. You can operate from anywhere in the world — we handle everything digitally.

items.q: Is a trade license required for my online store?
items.a: Yes. E-commerce activities require an E-commerce License from SHAMS. We help you choose the right license type.

items.q: How many business activities can I include in one license?
items.a: Depends on the license type. Many SHAMS licenses allow multiple activities — we help you maximize value.

items.q: Do I have to prepare a business plan for registration?
items.a: Not usually. Some activities may require additional documentation — we guide you on what's needed.

items.q: Is SHAMS cost-effective for new businesses?
items.a: Absolutely. SHAMS is one of the most affordable free zones for creative, digital, and freelance businesses — with no hidden fees.

items.q: Can I set up a SHAMS company without being in the UAE?
items.a: Yes. SHAMS allows 100% remote setup — no need to visit UAE.

items.q: Can I register an influencer brand or content creation company?
items.a: Yes! SHAMS is specifically designed for influencers, content creators, and media businesses.

items.q: Will you assist me after I have my license?
items.a: Yes. We provide post-setup support including license renewals, compliance, branding, and business growth services.
